text: Each section shall record a unique local section ID, kind (`code`, `rodata`, `data`, `runtime`, or `metadata`), alignment, exact u32 byte length, relative blob path, and SHA-256 of exact bytes. No host structure packing/endian/compression/implicit zero-fill/executable relocation expression shall be inferred. Zero bytes for a reserved dynamic global shall not initialize it.
